CREATE MODEL `project_id.mydataset.mymodel`
OPTIONS(MODEL_TYPE='DNN_LINEAR_COMBINED_CLASSIFIER',
        ACTIVATION_FN = 'RELU',
        BATCH_SIZE = 16,
        DROPOUT = 0.1,
        EARLY_STOP = FALSE,
        HIDDEN_UNITS = [128, 128, 128],
        INPUT_LABEL_COLS = ['mylabel'],
        LEARN_RATE=0.001,
        MAX_ITERATIONS = 50,
        OPTIMIZER = 'ADAGRAD')
AS SELECT * FROM `project_id.mydataset.mytable`
